description: Retrieve every season year in which a team has competed in FRC, sorted ascending. Returns a flat array of year integers. Use to bound year-based queries, drive per-year iteration, or determine a team's longevity and rookie year.

team_key.description: FRC team key formatted as 'frc' followed by the team number with no leading zeros (e.g., 'frc86', 'frc254', 'frc1114'). Uniquely identifies a FIRST Robotics Competition team on The Blue Alliance.

name: get_team_years_participated
